title: Vapouriz Premium Blueberry E-Liquid 10ml
description: Rich, sweet and elegantly simple, the pure, tangy taste of fresh blueberries is a classic flavour that never goes out of fashion. This delicious e-liquid from Vapouriz remains one of the original – and best – blueberry e-liquids and is a must for any fruity vape fan. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full collection of Vapouriz Premium E-Liquids and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Starter Vape Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options.
